failed_payment.reason: An involuntary lapse is not a decision to leave. Farewell framing hands a frictionless exit to someone who never chose one, and an ultimatum triggers a defensive reaction.

canceled_customer.reason: A canceled customer chose to leave. Framing their departure as a billing glitch or failed payment is false.

closed_lost_stale_deal.reason: Closed-lost deals get a review action only: no email play, no money claims.

note: Failed payment prohibits cancellation framing; canceled customer prohibits payment glitch framing; closed-lost prohibits email plays.
